Welcome to this journey—a chance for us to take a closer look at something many of us overlook: the quiet, everyday habits that shape who we really are.
Have you ever wondered why you’re drawn to certain things or why your heart seems to chase after dreams you can’t quite explain? The truth is, our desires often have more influence over our lives than what we actually believe or think.
In his book, You Are What You Love: The Spiritual Power of Habit, James K.A. Smith explores this idea in a way that’s both eye-opening and deeply personal. He helps us see how the routines we repeat every day—whether at work, in relationships, or even when we’re alone—aren’t just mindless actions. They’re powerful practices, quietly shaping our hearts and steering our lives, sometimes without us even noticing.
What if the real question isn’t “What do you think?” but “What do you love?” Imagine how different our choices might be if we paid attention to the things that capture our hearts, rather than just our minds.
Together, let’s explore how even the most ordinary moments can become sacred, and how the simple rhythms of life—those daily rituals and routines—hold the power to transform us from the inside out. Smith’s wisdom invites us to look beneath the surface, to notice how our communities, cultures, and personal habits shape what we truly value, often more than we realize.
As we move forward, you’ll discover that spiritual growth isn’t just about sheer willpower. It’s about intentionally nurturing what we love and desire—aligning our hearts and our habits in a way that leads toward a life of meaning, joy, and purpose.
So, let’s step into this together. Let’s uncover how the everyday can become extraordinary—and how, by reshaping what we love, we can set a new course for our lives.
